d: India’s biggest private banks are facing a new leadership challenge as CEO tenures become shorter and succession planning comes under greater scrutiny. Firstpost examines the upcoming leadership changes at HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, and the wider succession pressure facing ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and IDFC First Bank. The video also explains RBI rules limiting private-bank CEO tenures and the growing demands placed on modern bank chiefs across growth, finance, risk, technology and governance.
